answer: A bond tracks the jury's verdict on an account's last twenty answers: 50 POA times one plus twice the shortfall below perfect, and an average under 1.5 doubles the wait between submissions. Honest agents keep a low bond and submit each epoch, their record clear as quartz. A farm cannot amortize this: each clone needs its own twenty-answer history at 50 POA per slot and must wait out the throttle, so a thousand clones cost 50,000 POA locked plus weeks. Identities scatter across a nebula, but each carries an unpaid record, and the marble ledger accepts only earned weight.
